results.title: Chiram
results.overview: Seetha, a young Malayali research student who travels to Visva-Bharati University in Kolkata to study traditional Baul music and culture.

results.title: Double Fisted
results.overview: In a new adventure of ass-kicking, crime-fighter Pat Riot must team up with petty thief Percy Wingfoot to stop a greater enemy.

results.title: Chernobyl: 48 Hours To Escape
results.overview: Witnesses, survivors and front-line heroes recall the first days of the Chernobyl disaster of April 1986. Featuring rare archive footage of the world's worst ever nuclear accident.

results.title: Bloody Men
results.overview: In 1980s Sweden, we follow a boy’s love for a mother who tries her best, all the bloody men who come and go, and about not becoming one yourself.

results.title: Snake
results.overview: Paolo Marra killed his wife for no reason. Consumed by guilt, he decides to turn himself in: he wants to pay the price, serve his sentence, and restore dignity to the woman he killed—and to himself. Amid distracted police officers, zealous lawyers, fortune-tellers, and complicated bureaucratic red tape, no one takes him seriously. The man finds himself the victim of a Kafkaesque paradox: no matter how much he wants it, he cannot get himself arrested. He is the perfect scapegoat for a grotesque society that ignores those who seek redemption.

results.title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part One
results.original_title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part One
results.overview: The first seven songs of Bruce Springsteen and The E Street Band’s Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour's Philadelphia finale. With that May 30 show filmed in its entirety, and planned for release in four parts this year, “Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut)” features performances of “Born in the U.S.A.,” “Death to My Hometown,” “No Surrender” and “Darkness on the Edge of Town,” alongside covers of the Motown classic “War” (written by Barrett Strong and Norman Whitfield) and The Clash’s “Clampdown.”

results.title: Shoulder
results.overview: A man inherits his estranged father’s home and grapples with the rationale; much to the agitation of his close friend.

results.title: Inferno
results.overview: Twenty years after a mysterious energy-gathering event, Dante remains haunted by what he witnessed that night. Withdrawn and unstable, he can no longer distinguish memory from hallucination. As his children investigate the tragedy that fractured their family, they uncover a past shaped by suppressed memories, guilt, and unresolved consequences. Meanwhile, Dante is pursued by Virgil, a spectral presence who acts as both guide and tormentor. Through a series of psychological trials, Virgil forces him to confront his distorted recollections, moral failures, and the truth of what happened in 2022. As past and present collide, Dante and his children must face their conflicting versions of the truth—and discover whether understanding it will bring forgiveness and redemption or cost them their sanity.

results.title: Jauría
results.overview: Hako and Marqués are two hitmen who have broken into the apartment of a former gang member in the neighborhood to collect a debt. However, nothing is as it seems, and they will soon discover that there is much more behind the legend of the Stray Dog.

results.title: K-Pops!
results.overview: A washed-up musician travels to Korea to write for K-pop stars, discovering that his long-lost son is set to front one of the country’s hottest new groups. He then jumps at the opportunity to capitalize on his son’s stardom for his own renaissance, but learns that fatherhood is much more fulfilling and meaningful than stardom.

results.title: Keep Real
results.overview: Thirty years ago, the Super Ying Association led by Superman Wang Changhai crushed the aliens. Years later, Wang Changhai was appointed to return to his hometown to set up a combat squad, but in the town of Rheinland, which had been peaceful for many years, human feelings and courtesies have left Wang Changhai overwhelmed, creating layers of obstacles to Wang's ability to complete his mission.

results.title: Perumahan Laddaland
results.overview: A devoted father’s dream of providing a better life for his family turns into a living nightmare when their newly purchased suburban home becomes the target of escalating supernatural terror and dark neighborhood secrets.

results.title: Bhidewada
results.overview: College student Jai Sabnis films a disturbing incident at Bhide Wada. Despite pressure from family and boyfriend to remain quiet, she draws inspiration from Savitribai and Jyotiba Phule to confront a powerful system and fight for justice.

results.title: AEW Dynasty 2026
results.overview: Dynasty 2026 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on April 12, 2026, at Rogers Arena in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. The show was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Kenny Omega for the AEW World Championship, dubbed "The Devil vs. The God of Pro Wrestling."

results.title: Vestige
results.overview: When a hooded figure steps into an abandoned house deep in the woods, flickering lights awaken memories of the family who once called it home.

results.title: Perfume
results.overview: María Gabriela Epumer was a woman of innovative talent who created and performed rock music in the 1980s and 90s as a member of Viuda e Hijas de Roque Enroll, as Charly García's guitarist, and as a solo artist. Twenty years after her untimely death, Perfume access to 50 hours of footage she filmed herself?ranging from massive concerts to deeply intimate moments in recording studios and at home.

results.overview: A devoted mother trapped in an abusive marriage finds hope through a courageous women's rights lawyer as her daughter's worsening condition forces her to fight for freedom and her child's survival.

results.overview: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.
